test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A train with a length of 195 m overtakes a man moving at a speed of 5 km/hr (in the same direction) in 13 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another train that is 255 m long, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 76 km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of Train 1 w.r.t man = 195 ÷ 13 = 15 m/s = (15 × 18/5) = 54 km/hr.

Since both are moving in the same direction, actual speed of Train 1 = 54 + 5 = 59 km/hr.

Relative speed of the two trains (moving in opposite directions) = 59 + 76 = 135 km/hr.

Converting relative speed to m/s = 135 × (5/18) = 37.5 m/s.

Time required to completely cross = (195 + 255) ÷ 37.5 = 450 ÷ 37.5 = 12 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 195 m

Speed of the man (vₘ) = 5 km/hr

Time taken to overtake the man (t₁) = 13 seconds

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 255 m

Speed of Train 2 (v₂) = 76 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Relative Speed (same direction) = v₁ − v₂

Relative Speed (opposite direction) = v₁ + v₂

 
 Train 1 : 195 m
 

 v1 = 59 km/hr
 
 
 Train 2 : 255 m
 

 v2 = 76 km/hr

 
• 

 Relative Speed = 59 + 76 = 135 km/hr = 37.5 m/s
 Total Distance = 195 + 255 = 450 m
 Time = 450 ÷ 37.5 = 12 seconds

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed of Train 1 w.r.t the man = L₁ ÷ t₁ = 195 ÷ 13 = 15 m/s

⇒ Convert relative speed into km/hr = 15 × (18/5) = 54 km/hr

⇒ Since the man is moving in the same direction, relative speed = v₁ − 5

⇒ v₁ − 5 = 54

⇒ Speed of Train 1 (v₁) = 59 km/hr

⇒ When crossing Train 2, total distance to cover = L₁ + L₂ = 195 + 255 = 450 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = v₁ + v₂ = 59 + 76 = 135 km/hr

⇒ Convert this relative speed into m/s = 135 × (5/18) = 37.5 m/s

⇒ Time required to cross Train 2 = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 450 ÷ 37.5 = 12 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 12 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = (S₁ + S₂).

Trains Crossing Point Objects

When a train crosses a stationary man, pole, or tree, the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train itself.

Unit Conversion Rule

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
